basic_info.description: Stunning 2-Unit Property in the Heart of Richmond District, both units to be delivered vacant.  This grand property features two expansive flats, each offering over 2,000 square feet of elegant living space, totaling over 4,000 square feet. Perfect for large families, multi-generational living, or savvy investors, this home combines timeless charm with unparalleled versatility.  Each unit boasts 3 spacious bedrooms and 1 bathroom. Enjoy the comfort of a welcoming living room filled with natural light and a formal dining room that exudes classic elegance, perfect for hosting gatherings. The kitchens are complemented by charming breakfast nooks, Both units are equipped with convenient in-unit laundry rooms.  The top-floor unit comes with an added bonusa versatile room on the upper level, perfect as a home office, playroom, or guest space. Downstairs, the immense 4-car garage provides generous parking and storage in the full basement with high ceilings presents limitless potential for workshops, home gyms, or future development. The backyard offers a serene outdoor retreat, ready for gardening, entertaining, or relaxation.  Close proximity to Golden Gate Park, excellent schools, shops, and restaurants, this unique property delivers exceptional living and investment opportunities.
